add_locations.name: jo9_smuggler_contract_catalog
add_locations.body:
! JO9 MOD START SMUGGLER_CONTRACT_STOCK_20261127_CATALOG
killvar 'jo9_contract_items'
killvar 'jo9_contract_prices'
! Register future unique entries here.
! jo9_contract_items[] = character_id & jo9_contract_prices[character_id] = price_in_sparks
! JO9 MOD END SMUGGLER_CONTRACT_STOCK_20261127_CATALOG

add_locations.name: jo9_smuggler_contract
add_locations.body:
! JO9 MOD START SMUGGLER_CONTRACT_STOCK_20261127_TRADE if $args[0] = 'help': $smuggler_info[16] = '[발랄라이카]
 나한테 노예를 찾아 달라고 주문해 놓고 인수 날짜까지 나타나지 않는 노예상도 있어. 기한이 지나면 내가 처분해. 그런 건 특별 상품에 따로 올려 두지. 이름이랑 값은 거기서 확인해.' exit end if $args[0] = 'available': result = 0 local jo9_contract_id, jo9_contract_i, $jo9_contract_slot jo9_contract_id = args[1] if jo9_contract_id <= 0 or jo9_contract_prices[jo9_contract_id] <= 0: exit if $seed_name[jo9_contract_id] = '' or $seed_name[jo9_contract_id] = 'blank' or $seed_name[jo9_contract_id] = 'пусто' or $fullimage[jo9_contract_id] = '': exit if black_market_taken[str(jo9_contract_id)] > 0: exit for jo9_contract_i = 0 to arrsize('$all_slave_characters') - 1: $jo9_contract_slot = $all_slave_characters[jo9_contract_i] if dyneval('result = ' + $jo9_contract_slot + '_state > 0 and ' + $jo9_contract_slot + '_type = ' + str(jo9_contract_id)) = 1: exit end result = 1 exit end if $args[0] = 'menu': gs 'jo9_smuggler_contract_catalog' local jo9_contract_index, jo9_contract_item, jo9_contract_count, $jo9_contract_exec func('$menu', '===BEGIN===', 'column_0') for jo9_contract_index = 0 to arrsize('jo9_contract_items') - 1: jo9_contract_item = jo9_contract_items[jo9_contract_index] if func('jo9_smuggler_contract', 'available', jo9_contract_item) = 1: jo9_contract_count += 1 $jo9_contract_exec = 'jo9_contract_quote_id = <> & interaction_city = 62130 & gt "interaction_city"' func('$menu', 'exec_options', $menu_item_Orderparcel2, $jo9_contract_exec, '<<$seed_name[jo9_contract_item]>> ($<>)') end end if jo9_contract_count = 0: $sp_text[3] = '[발랄라이카]
 지금은 내놓을 계약 파기 상품이 없어.' else $sp_text[3] = '[발랄라이카]
 인수 기한이 지난 주문들이야. 관심 가는 물건이 있으면 골라 봐.' end func('$menu', 'exec_options', $menu_item_nobuy, 'sp_txt = 1 & gt $curloc', '돌아간다') func('$menu', '===END===') exit end if $args[0] = 'quote': gs 'jo9_smuggler_contract_catalog' local jo9_contract_quote, jo9_contract_cost jo9_contract_quote = args[1] if func('jo9_smuggler_contract', 'available', jo9_contract_quote) = 1: jo9_contract_cost = jo9_contract_prices[jo9_contract_quote] $text[1] = '[발랄라이카]
 <<$seed_name[jo9_contract_quote]>>? <>스파크야.' if slave_state ! CONST_INT['no_slave']: $text[1] += '
 먼저 데리고 온 노예부터 보내고 와.' elseif sparks < jo9_contract_cost: $text[1] += '
 돈이 모자라. 값에 맞춰 가져와.' else $text[1] += '

<>스파크를 내고 산다' end else $text[1] = '[발랄라이카]
 그 물건은 이제 없다.' end if instr($text[1], 'id="jo9-contract-buy"') > 0: $text[1] += '
' else $text[1] += '

' end $text[1] += '이번에는 사지 않는다' exit end if $args[0] = 'buy': if $curloc ! 'interaction_screen_city' or $place ! 'smugglers_den' or interaction_city ! 62130: exit local jo9_contract_buy, jo9_contract_cost jo9_contract_buy = args[1] if jo9_contract_buy ! jo9_contract_quote_id: exit gs 'jo9_smuggler_contract_catalog' jo9_contract_cost = jo9_contract_prices[jo9_contract_buy] if func('jo9_smuggler_contract', 'available', jo9_contract_buy) = 1 and jo9_contract_cost = args[2] and sparks >= jo9_contract_cost and slave_state = CONST_INT['no_slave']: special_stock = jo9_contract_buy killvar '$special_age' gs 'generate_stock' if stock_state = CONST_INT['slave_exist'] and stock_type = jo9_contract_buy: if func('stock_to_slave_nogt') = 1: slave['brand'] = 0 tattoo_brand = 0 sparks -= jo9_contract_cost black_market_taken[str(jo9_contract_buy)] = 1 gs '$slave_price' if sound_on = 1: play 'contentsndkkm.wav', sound_volume end end end jo9_contract_quote_id = 0 sp_txt = 3 gt 'shop_general' end ! JO9 MOD END SMUGGLER_CONTRACT_STOCK_20261127_TRADE
